mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses discount rates and increases equity present value, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 0.5% signals monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS below 0.1% and CPIAUCSL monthly growth exceeding 0.5% indicates delayed rate hikes in growth inflation, boosting equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.5% monthly but 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 6.5%) triggers Fed accommodation that supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 1400) indicate robust consumer demand and construction activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Low housing starts (HOUST below 1400) signal residential sector contraction, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous INDPRO decline (below 100) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate below 0.5% annualized) indicate manufacturing slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when INDPRO < 100 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized but 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market growth (PAYEMS growth rate below 0.1% annualized) signals need for continued monetary stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth rate is below 0.1%.
